headline: Fishermans Row Goes Wholly Colonial as Great Fronts Seethe
war_summary: Three hours on, the balance has shifted again: the last Warden-held work in Fishermans Row has passed into Colonial hands, leaving all nine of its strategic posts under one banner after forty-one base events in the day, while Stlican Shelf's count now reads five Warden to four Colonial, its flags busy late at Thornhold. The Weathered Expanse keeps its five-Colonial-to-four tally, yet the slaughter there quickens past three thousand men an hour combined, Frostmarch alone logging twenty-five events. The Linn of Mercy returns to the wire: Lathair saw flags into the evening, and hourly Warden losses run half again the Colonial as rates climb. Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle likewise bleed at better than two thousand an hour apiece. Mooring County, by contrast, has cooled to a trickle after its morning storms, though the Wind Hills accounted for a dozen events. Nevish Line and Callahans Passage show no flag movement but post heavy, accelerating tolls, the former now near eleven hundred Colonial casualties the hour. Day 293 of the war; no victor declared, thirty-four victory towns required.
